confidence_reasons: mean valid-pixel share of the observations used: 100%
0% of the footprint is uncertain (cloud or gaps) and excluded
limitations: Spatial resolution is about 25 m per pixel; boundary shifts smaller than ~2 pixels are treated as positional noise.
Only Jan were compared so that seasons match; other months were not used for the start/end maps.
Fewer than five yearly composites exist, so the year-to-year scatter test could not be applied.
The data describe where and how much water extent changed. They cannot, by themselves, establish why.
what_was_analysed: Same-season composites of 1984 (1 observations) and 2021 (1 observations), using only Jan so seasons match. A pixel counts as water if it is water in at least 50% of its valid observations; 0 ha (0%) were uncertain and excluded.
